info.description:
REST API for the AURA Tech store: storefront, cart and checkout, customer accounts and the admin backoffice.
Every response uses the same envelope: `{ success, data, meta, error }`. Amounts are in satang (1 baht = 100 satang).
Guests are identified by the `X-Guest-Session-ID` header (the API issues one on the first request and returns it in the same header).

patch.description:
Moves an order to a new status (only allowed transitions) and saves serial numbers per order item (one per unit; a blank entry keeps the saved serial).
SHIPPED requires a serial for every unit plus `carrier` (KERRY, FLASH or DHL) and `tracking_number`. CANCELLED returns the order's stock (reserved and already committed).
Moving to SHIPPED, DELIVERED or CANCELLED writes the matching customer email, and every change is recorded in the activity log.
`data` is an object with `message` and `status` (the new status).

post.description: Changes one variant's physical stock. mode "delta" adds quantity (may be negative, not 0); mode "set" makes stock equal quantity (a physical count). reason is one of RECEIVE, COUNT, DAMAGE or RETURN; a note is required for COUNT and DAMAGE (max 500 characters). Pass expected_stock (the stock you saw) to refuse the change if stock moved since. Stock cannot go below zero or below units held in checkout. Every change appends to the stock ledger, may send back-in-stock emails to waiting customers, and is written to the audit log.

get.description: Returns the monthly payment for each supported bank and term (3, 6 or 10 months) for the given amount.

post.description:
Processes the simulated payment for a PENDING_PAYMENT order placed by the same customer or guest session. On success the reserved stock is committed,
the order moves to PAID_PROCESSING and the order-confirmation email is written. Card numbers ending in 0000 are declined (402) and the reservation is kept.
INSTALLMENT_0 requires `installment_plan` with bank KBANK, SCB, KRUNGSRI or BBL and 3, 6 or 10 months.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

parameters.name: body

Turns the current bag (of the signed-in customer, or of the guest session) into a PENDING_PAYMENT order and holds its stock for 15 minutes.
